description:
Discover the complex and controversial life of Nettala Muthappa Rai Derla, a name that once commanded fear and respect across Bangalore, Karnataka. From his early days operating in the underworld to his eventual transition into a legitimate businessman, philanthropist, and social activist, this documentary explores the multifaceted legacy he left behind.

In this video, we trace the journey of Muthappa Rai, examining how an ordinary man rose through the ranks of the criminal underworld, his influence in Bangalore, and his later-life efforts to reshape his public image through charity and community work. Join us as we separate the myth from reality in the life of one of India's most talked-about figures.

What you'll learn in this video:
► The early life and origins of Nettala Muthappa Rai Derla
► How he rose to prominence in the Bangalore underworld
► The pivotal transition from criminal figure to businessman
► His philanthropic contributions and social activism later in life
► The lasting legacy and impact he left in Karnataka
